embeds.title: SERVER MAP
embeds.description: Every category has a job. Use the right room and the server stays useful instead of becoming one giant chat.

fields.name: 🏛️ LEAGUE OFFICE
fields.value: Governance, constitution, announcements, calendar, ledger, voting, the hall of champions and league records.

fields.name: 📰 THE WIRE
fields.value: Breaking NHL news, injuries, transactions, prospects and league-wide news discussion.

fields.name: 💼 GENERAL MANAGERS
fields.value: The clubhouse: GM Lounge, game-day talk, chirps, memes, off-topic conversation and media.

fields.name: 🔄 TRADE CENTER
fields.value: Trade blocks, acquisition targets, trade discussion, completed trades and dynasty player values.

fields.name: 🌱 SCOUTING DEPARTMENT
fields.value: One prospect forum covering college, juniors, Europe, the AHL, the NHL Draft and the BLHA draft, sorted by tags.

fields.name: 💵 WAIVER WIRE
fields.value: FAAB strategy, recently dropped players and players worth watching. Actual claims remain in Fantrax.

fields.name: 🏆 LEAGUE COMPETITION
fields.value: Weekly scoreboards, standings, recaps, playoffs and the consolation bracket.

fields.name: 🏢 COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE
fields.value: Private tickets, public rules questions and league suggestions.

fields.name: 🎙️ DRAFT CENTER
fields.value: Startup and annual draft announcements, round results, draft-day trades and live discussion. Fantrax sends the on-the-clock alerts.

fields.name: 🏒 FRANCHISE HQ
fields.value: Franchise-specific spaces for team identity, planning and internal organization.
